test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

I said that when it stopped drizzling we would have to start digging again.

options.text: I said, “When it stopped to drizzle we must start digging again.”
I said, “When it stops drizzling we must start digging again.”
I said, “When drizzle will stop then we will start digging again.”
I said, “When it stops to drizzle we will start digging again.”

solution:
The correct answer is: "**I said, 'When it stops drizzling we must start digging again.**'"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Direct speech involves repeating the exact words spoken by someone.
 
• In this sentence, the speaker is reporting their own words, so they would say "**I said**" before repeating the sentence.
 
• The tense of the reported speech should match the tense of the or
